summary: This joint resolution proposes a constitutional amendment to prohibit individuals who are not U.S. citizens, nationals, or lawful permanent residents from voting in any federal, state, tribal, or local election.

scores.thoughts: This bill proposes a constitutional amendment to prohibit non-citizens, non-nationals, and non-lawful permanent residents from voting in any election. This directly relates to securing elections by defining who is eligible to vote, aligning with the 'enforce voter ID and secure elections' end of the spectrum.
